verses.en: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
verses.pt: Antes da festa da páscoa, sabendo Jesus que era chegada a sua hora de passar deste mundo para o Pai, e havendo amado os seus que estavam no mundo, amou-os até o fim.
verses.en_web: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.
verses.en_bbe: Now before the feast of the Passover, it was clear to Jesus that the time had come for him to go away from this world to the Father. Having once had love for those in the world who were his, his love for them went on to the end.

verses.en: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him;
verses.pt: Enquanto ceavam, tendo já o Diabo posto no coração de Judas, filho de Simão Iscariotes, que o traísse,
verses.en_web: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,
verses.en_bbe: So while a meal was going on, the Evil One having now put it into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to be false to him,

verses.en: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;
verses.pt: Jesus, sabendo que o Pai lhe entregara tudo nas mãos, e que viera de Deus e para Deus voltava,
verses.en_web: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God, and was going to God,
verses.en_bbe: Jesus, being conscious that the Father had put everything into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,

verses.en: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.
verses.pt: levantou-se da ceia, tirou o manto e, tomando uma toalha, cingiu-se.
verses.en_web: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel, and wrapped a towel around his waist.
verses.en_bbe: Got up from table, put off his robe and took a cloth and put it round him.

verses.en: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
verses.pt: Depois deitou água na bacia e começou a lavar os pés aos discípulos, e a enxugar-lhos com a toalha com que estava cingido.
verses.en_web: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.
verses.en_bbe: Then he put water into a basin and was washing the feet of the disciples and drying them with the cloth which was round him.

verses.en: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?
verses.pt: Chegou, pois, a Simão Pedro, que lhe disse: Senhor, lavas-me os pés a mim?
verses.en_web: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”
verses.en_bbe: So he came to Simon Peter. Peter said, Lord, are my feet to be washed by you?

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: O que eu faço, tu não o sabes agora; mas depois o entenderás.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus, answering, said to him, What I do is not clear to you now, but it will be clear to you in time to come.

verses.en: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.
verses.pt: Tornou-lhe Pedro: Nunca me lavarás os pés. Replicou-lhe Jesus: Se eu não te lavar, não tens parte comigo.
verses.en_web: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”
verses.en_bbe: Peter said, I will never let my feet be washed by you, never. Jesus said in answer, If I do not make you clean you have no part with me.

verses.en: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe Simão Pedro: Senhor, não somente os meus pés, mas também as mãos e a cabeça.
verses.en_web: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”
verses.en_bbe: Simon Peter said to him, Lord, not my feet only, but my hands and my head.

verses.en: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Aquele que se banhou não necessita de lavar senão os pés, pois no mais está todo limpo; e vós estais limpos, mas não todos.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said to him, He who is bathed has need only to have his feet washed and then he is clean all over: and you, my disciples, are clean, but not all of you.

verses.en: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.
verses.pt: Pois ele sabia quem o estava traindo; por isso disse: Nem todos estais limpos.
verses.en_web: For he knew him who would betray him, therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”
verses.en_bbe: (He had knowledge who was false to him; that is why he said, You are not all clean.)

verses.en: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?
verses.pt: Ora, depois de lhes ter lavado os pés, tomou o manto, tornou a reclinar-se à mesa e perguntou-lhes: Entendeis o que vos tenho feito?
verses.en_web: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?
verses.en_bbe: Then, after washing their feet and putting on his robe again, he took his seat and said to them, Do you see what I have done to you?

verses.en: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.
verses.pt: Vós me chamais Mestre e Senhor; e dizeis bem, porque eu o sou.
verses.en_web: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.
verses.en_bbe: You give me the name of Master and Lord: and you are right; that is what I am.

verses.en: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another’s feet.
verses.pt: Ora, se eu, o Senhor e Mestre, vos lavei os pés, também vós deveis lavar os pés uns aos outros.
verses.en_web: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
verses.en_bbe: If then I, the Lord and the Master, have made your feet clean, it is right for you to make one another's feet clean.

verses.en: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.
verses.pt: Porque eu vos dei exemplo, para que, como eu vos fiz, façais vós também.
verses.en_web: For I have given you an example, that you also should do as I have done to you.
verses.en_bbe: I have given you an example, so that you may do what I have done to you.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.
verses.pt: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo: Não é o servo maior do que o seu senhor, nem o enviado maior do que aquele que o enviou.
verses.en_web: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither one who is sent greater than he who sent him.
verses.en_bbe: Truly I say to you, A servant is not greater than his lord; and he who is sent is not greater than the one who sent him.

verses.en: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.
verses.pt: Se sabeis estas coisas, bem-aventurados sois se as praticardes.
verses.en_web: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
verses.en_bbe: If these things are clear to you, happy are you if you do them.

verses.en: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.
verses.pt: Não falo de todos vós; eu conheço aqueles que escolhi; mas para que se cumprisse a escritura: O que comia do meu pão, levantou contra mim o seu calcanhar.
verses.en_web: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen. But that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’
verses.en_bbe: I am not talking of you all: I have knowledge of my true disciples, but things are as they are, so that the Writings may come true, The foot of him who takes bread with me is lifted up against me.

verses.en: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he.
verses.pt: Desde já no-lo digo, antes que suceda, para que, quando suceder, creiais que eu sou.
verses.en_web: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.
verses.en_bbe: From this time forward, I give you knowledge of things before they come about, so that when they come about you may have belief that I am he.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
verses.pt: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo: Quem receber aquele que eu enviar, a mim me recebe; e quem me recebe a mim, recebe aquele que me enviou.
verses.en_web: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”
verses.en_bbe: Truly I say to you, He who takes to his heart anyone whom I send, takes me to his heart; and he who so takes me, takes him who sent me.

verses.en: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
verses.pt: Tendo Jesus dito isto, turbou-se em espírito, e declarou: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo que um de vós me há de trair.
verses.en_web: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”
verses.en_bbe: When Jesus had said this he was troubled in spirit, and gave witness, saying, Truly I say to you, that one of you will be false to me.

verses.en: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
verses.pt: Os discípulos se entreolhavam, perplexos, sem saber de quem ele falava.
verses.en_web: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.
verses.en_bbe: Then the eyes of the disciples were turned on one another, in doubt as to whom he had in mind.

verses.en: Now there was leaning on Jesus’ bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
verses.pt: Ora, achava-se reclinado sobre o peito de Jesus um de seus discípulos, aquele a quem Jesus amava.
verses.en_web: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ breast.
verses.en_bbe: There was at table one of his disciples, the one dear to Jesus, resting his head on Jesus' breast.

verses.en: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.
verses.pt: A esse, pois, fez Simão Pedro sinal, e lhe pediu: Pergunta- lhe de quem é que fala.
verses.en_web: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”
verses.en_bbe: Making a sign to him, Simon Peter said, Who is it he is talking about?

verses.en: He then lying on Jesus’ breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
verses.pt: Aquele discípulo, recostando-se assim ao peito de Jesus, perguntou-lhe: Senhor, quem é?
verses.en_web: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ breast, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”
verses.en_bbe: He, then, resting his head on Jesus' breast, said to him, Lord, who is it?

verses.en: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.
verses.pt: Respondeu Jesus: É aquele a quem eu der o pedaço de pão molhado. Tendo, pois, molhado um bocado de pão, deu-o a Judas, filho de Simão Iscariotes.
verses.en_web: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
verses.en_bbe: This was the answer Jesus gave: It is the one to whom I will give this bit of bread after I have put it in the vessel. Then he took the bit of bread, put it into the vessel, and gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

verses.en: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.
verses.pt: E, logo após o bocado, entrou nele Satanás. Disse-lhe, pois, Jesus: O que fazes, faze-o depressa.
verses.en_web: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”
verses.en_bbe: And when Judas took the bread Satan went into him. Then Jesus said to him, Do quickly what you have to do.

verses.en: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
verses.pt: E nenhum dos que estavam à mesa percebeu a que propósito lhe disse isto;
verses.en_web: Now no man at the table knew why he said this to him.
verses.en_bbe: Now it was not clear to anyone at table why he said this to him.

verses.en: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
verses.pt: pois, como Judas tinha a bolsa, pensavam alguns que Jesus lhe queria dizer: Compra o que nos é necessário para a festa; ou, que desse alguma coisa aos pobres.
verses.en_web: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.
verses.en_bbe: Some were of the opinion that because Judas kept the money-bag Jesus said to him, Get the things we have need of for the feast; or, that he was to give something to the poor.

verses.en: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.
verses.pt: Então ele, tendo recebido o bocado saiu logo. E era noite.
verses.en_web: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.
verses.en_bbe: So Judas, having taken the bit of bread, straight away went out: and it was night.

verses.en: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.
verses.pt: Tendo ele, pois, saído, disse Jesus: Agora é glorificado o Filho do homem, e Deus é glorificado nele;
verses.en_web: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.
verses.en_bbe: Then when he had gone out, Jesus said, Now is glory given to the Son of man, and God is given glory in him.

verses.en: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.
verses.pt: se Deus é glorificado nele, também Deus o glorificará em si mesmo, e logo o há de glorificar.
verses.en_web: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.
verses.en_bbe: If God is given glory in him, God will give him glory in himself, and will give him glory even now.

verses.en: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.
verses.pt: Filhinhos, ainda por um pouco estou convosco. Procurar-me- eis; e, como eu disse aos judeus, também a vós o digo agora: Para onde eu vou, não podeis vós ir.
verses.en_web: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.
verses.en_bbe: My dear children, I am only to be with you a little longer. Then you will be looking for me: and as I said to the Jews, so now I say to you, Where I am going you may not come.

verses.en: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
verses.pt: Um novo mandamento vos dou: que vos ameis uns aos outros; assim como eu vos amei a vós, que também vós vos ameis uns aos outros.
verses.en_web: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
verses.en_bbe: I give you a new law: Have love one for another; even as I have had love for you, so are you to have love one for another.

verses.en: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
verses.pt: Nisto conhecerão todos que sois meus discípulos, se tiverdes amor uns aos outros.
verses.en_web: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”
verses.en_bbe: By this it will be clear to all men that you are my disciples, if you have love one for another.

verses.en: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.
verses.pt: Perguntou-lhe Simão Pedro: Senhor, para onde vais? Respondeu Jesus; Para onde eu vou, não podes agora seguir-me; mais tarde, porém, me seguirás.
verses.en_web: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”
verses.en_bbe: Simon Peter said to him, Lord, where are you going? Jesus said in answer, Where I am going you may not come with me now, but you will come later.

verses.en: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe Pedro: Por que não posso seguir-te agora? Por ti darei a minha vida.
verses.en_web: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”
verses.en_bbe: Peter said to him, Why may I not come with you even now? I will give up my life for you.

verses.en: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.
verses.pt: Respondeu Jesus: Darás a tua vida por mim? Em verdade, em verdade te digo: Não cantará o galo até que me tenhas negado três vezes.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said in answer, Will you give up your life for me? Truly I say to you, Before the cry of the cock you will have said three times that you are not my disciple.
